operations.title: The integral Kummer wall image is primitive and saturated
operations.body: For kappa=sqrt(2)k at s=-3+2sqrt(2), the two-wall image is (1+sqrt(2),-sqrt(2),-1-sqrt(2),0). Since 1+sqrt(2) has norm -1, it is a unit and the image line is primitive and saturated over Z[sqrt(2)]. The top residue cancels exactly. Thus the sole integral index is the source-line F2 defect; the wall map adds no index. Physical activation remains undefined.
